claim.hypothesis: The introduction of social distancing measures is associated with a decrease in mobility.
claim.hypothesis_location: The relation is mentioned in the first paragraph and explicitly stated in third (the paper has only four paragraphs) where the results are reported.
claim.statement: Social distancing measures decreased the mobility by anadditional 23% (95% CI: 20%, 27%).

original_results.summary: The mobility in general decreased in the discussed period. Social distancing measures decreased the mobility by an additional 23% (95% CI: 20%, 27%).

human_result_summary: Human team (Fedor/Capitan/Capitan, SCORE project Malik_covid_wx5k_996g): multilevel mixed-effects model on 39 cities x 25 days (n=975); lockdown coefficient -25.68 (95% CI -27.96, -23.40), z=-22.08, p<.001, i.e. distancing cut mobility a further ~26% vs the original 23% (CI 20-27). Successful replication per SCORE criteria (negative significant lockdown coefficient).

tolerance.note: Replicated = same sign, statistically significant at the paper's threshold, and effect size in the same ballpark as the human report.
